model_rule: Shell commands verify correctness, not LLM judgment
commands_run: Manual trace: find-gaps.ts lines 426-499 (extension-based validation switch)

findings.gap: The runCheck() function has a fully functional `check.type === 'ai'` branch that dispatches LLM calls to verify work, directly contradicting the 'Checks, Not Vibes' principle that shell commands should verify correctness, not LLM judgment.
findings.evidence: find-gaps.ts line 536: `if (check.type === 'ai')` gates a full AI check flow that calls runAiCheck(), constructs prompts, invokes LLMs, and parses JSON responses. The deprecation warning on lines 537-542 is non-blocking — AI checks execute fully. ai-check.ts (229 lines) is actively maintained with prompt construction, provider selection, and graceful degradation.
findings.correction: Reject any check with `type: 'ai'` at task compile/load time instead of emitting a non-blocking warning. Remove the ai-check.ts module entirely. The deprecation warning is insufficient — the framework must structurally prevent the anti-pattern.
findings.test_to_write: tests/check-rejects-ai-type.test.ts — test that a task with `type: ai` in its checks list fails at compile time with a clear error message

findings.gap: Content validation (non-empty, parseable) is only performed for .png, .jpg, .html, and .json outputs. The most common Converge output format — .md — only gets an existsSync check. An LLM writing an empty or nonsensical .md file passes built-in output validation.
findings.evidence: find-gaps.ts lines 426-499: the extension-based switch only covers png (line 432), jpg (line 439), html (line 462), and json (line 469). All other extensions — including .md, .ts, .js, .txt — fall through to line 389: `existsSync(absOutputPath)`. No non-empty check, no content integrity guard.
findings.correction: Add a ValidationRuleSets.markdown(output) rule set that validates .md files are non-empty and have reasonable size (> 0 bytes). Apply it in the extension switch in findGaps(). At minimum, check non-emptiness for all text-based outputs.
findings.test_to_write: tests/output-content-validation.test.ts — test that a task producing an empty .md output file generates a corrupted-output gap
